wrong.sentence: In 2025 warehouse headcount grew by 7%.
Harbourline owned 1,840 trailers at the end of 2025.
wrong.why: The Document gives 1,840 as the number of drivers employed at the end of 2025, not trailers.

wrong.sentence: Insurance cost Harbourline £14.2m in 2025.
wrong.why: The review gives £14.2m as fuel costs, not insurance cost.

wrong.sentence: Late deliveries fell 18% from 2024.
Customers took 2.4 days on average to pay their invoices in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document says the average delivery took 2.4 days from order to doorstep in 2025, not that customers took 2.4 days to pay their invoices. The invoice payment figure is not established.

wrong.sentence: Rail partners carried Harbourline's freight 96 million kilometres in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document says the fleet drove 96 million kilometres in 2025, not that rail partners carried freight.

wrong.sentence: Water use per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document's 11% fall is for carbon emissions per tonne, not water use per tonne.

wrong.sentence: Earnings were 6.5p per share.
wrong.why: The Document gives 6.5p per share as a proposed final dividend, not as earnings: "The board proposes a final dividend of 6.5p per share." No passage states earnings per share of 6.5p.

wrong.sentence: Free cash flow came to £38m in 2025.
Felixstowe depot's space occupancy was 94% in 2025.
wrong.why: The Documents give Felixstowe's 94% as an on-time rate, not space occupancy.

right.sentence: Harbourline employed 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025.
An average delivery took 2.4 days in 2025.
The fleet covered 96 million kilometres in 2025.
Carbon emissions per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
The final dividend is 6.5p per share.
